item.title: Practical Experience
item.author: junyi.h@comp.nus.edu.sg (Junyi Hou)
item.description: ## Hugging Face Shared Cache Fodler https://benjijang.com/posts/2024/01/shared-hf-cache/ https://github.com/bstee615/shared-hf-cache It&rsquo;s not work in practical. users /etc/profile is different. it says that editing ~/.bashrc by setting HF_HOME and umask=002 to automatically set the permission of created folder. However, you can&rsquo;t ensure the user is using bash or zsh, or changing to fish. you can&rsquo;t guarantee the permission is always set. It always facing the permission error. I won&rsquo;t suggest to do this. You can let the user set the cache folder manually, but cannot automatically set the cache folder.

item.title: 科研路上的思考与实践
item.author: junyi.h@comp.nus.edu.sg (Junyi Hou)
item.description: # 引言 本文整理自每周组会的讨论内容，涵盖了科研工作的全流程经验与思考。从阅读论文到撰写研究，从方法论设计到实验执行，这些内容旨在为科研新手提供实用的指导，帮助建立正确的科研思维和工作方法。 # 读 Paper 看 paper 解决什么问题，比看它用什么方法要更重要 有创新吗？如果大家都是这么做的，就不算创新。（如果要其他人做这个事情，其他人也会这么做）
